narrative:
Good morning. Here is the FY2027 occupancy & revenue plan snapshot for VITREA Group.

**Revenue** is planned at EUR 1.27B — up 5.2% on the FY2026 forecast and EUR 30M short of the EUR 1.30B ambition. Inpatient rehab contributes EUR 949M (75%); outpatient rehab is the fastest-growing facility type.

**Occupancy** in rehab is 87.2% against an 88% target, with an average length of stay of 24.9 days and about 2.9m care days planned.

**EBITDA** is EUR 130M — a 10.2% margin. Daily-rate increases cover most of the tariff wage round.

**Key movements this week:**
• Paracelsus clinics filling faster than planned after DRV allocation changes
• First DRV regional contracts settled at +4.5%
• Swiss rehab occupancy below 85% while cantonal tariffs are pending

**Pending your decision:** agent proposals on care days, daily rates and workforce are waiting for approval.

signals.title: Nine Paracelsus rehabilitation clinics integrated (2025)
signals.excerpt: Nine rehabilitation clinics acquired from Paracelsus add German inpatient rehab capacity; occupancy ramp-up is the key FY2027 assumption.

signals.title: Carve-out completed — PAI Partners 67%, Fresenius 33%
signals.excerpt: The former Vamed rehabilitation business operates as VITREA, owned 67% by PAI Partners and 33% by Fresenius; standalone functions replace transitional services.

signals.title: Daily rates vs tariff wages
signals.excerpt: DRV +4.5%, GKV +3.8%, AT index +3.0% against a tariff wage round of about +5% (planning assumption).
